name: Chill Medicated CBD All Day Gummies | Watermelon
description:
Fresh relief, no matter where the day takes you.

Naturally flavored and infused with 25mg of premium broad-spectrum CBD per gummy, these watermelon gummies are a refreshingly easy way to feel better, without the fog. No matter if you’re looking to ease stress, support your mood, or just to relax a little easier, this go-to fits into your daily wellness routine seamlessly. 

Vegan, Gluten-Free, and Non-GMO
Made with pectin (not gelatin), sweet potato extract for color, and other clean ingredients. No artificial junk. Just functional, plant-based relief. 

Consistent, Reliable Dosing
Every piece is precisely dosed for the same clear-headed effect every time. No guesswork, no surprises.

Tastes Like a Treat
Naturally sweetened with fruit and vegetable juice, these gummies are a delicious nighttime wind-down that feels more like a dessert than a supplement. 

Clean Ingredients
No artificial dyes. No synthetic flavors. Just real ingredients that taste good and feel even better. These gummies are vegan-friendly, gluten-free, and made with natural colorants from fruit and veggies.

1 Gummy = 25mg CBD

MADE WITH HEMP GROWN IN THE USA
